steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ in evaluation without creating or searching for another event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the test configuration.
Reach the RFQ stage page where Edit Evaluation Time is available.
Open Edit Evaluation Time, decrease the duration by 10 minutes, and verify the saved end time is the previous end minus 10 minutes and remains after now and bidding end.
